sources.name: Ticket 4821
sources.title: Checkout fails for EU cards
sources.text: Since Monday, 23 customers in Germany and France report that card payments fail at checkout with error 402. The payments team rolled back release 3.8.1 on Wednesday and the failures stopped.

sources.name: Ticket 4830
sources.title: Invoices show the wrong VAT
sources.text: Two business customers in Spain received invoices with 21% VAT instead of the reverse charge. Finance is reissuing both invoices.
